title: KeelWake: refresh stale wave densities and preserve bounded experiment evidence
body:
KeelWake refreshes the density for an already-selected incoming wave when matched danger labels have changed since its cached estimate. The selected waves, aiming, power and movement objective remain otherwise unchanged; production AISurvivor and the original Keel baseline remain unchanged.

Prospective registration: issue #118 and `docs/improvements/keel-wake-v1.md`. Screen: 14 games / 120 rounds against Diamond Port, Retcon and pinned samples with fresh Keel controls. Only a full screen pass permits the registered fresh 18-game / 300-round confirmation. No retries, replacement games, historical controls or competitive result is claimed.

Candidate JAR SHA256: `9dfc691b0e3a1879f568ab0c9897a14fcc6f6e1936d2208ff46d05fe62f3f78f`. The actual first pinned Java17 build passed 29 JUnit tests and two byte-identical builds. Local independent harness/reader review reproduced 76 and 86 tests, including isolated full screen/confirmation evidence fixtures. Source, original build artifact, review snapshots and failures are preserved in candidate validation and `benchmarks/keel-wake-v1/`.

Full reviewed harness/reader source is published at `165d2ca819413881ecd582959924f3b6a6de8c1f`; same-head pinned Python3.13/Java17 CI is running. Final freeze, published-head independent source clearance, local audit-storage gate and fresh worker runtime approval remain pending. Measured Wake budget remains 0 screen / 0 confirmation rounds. No source-clearance or dispatch token is present.

Preparation failure preserved separately: three unintended inherited CI games / three rounds before branch-guard repair, with no Wake/Keel participants. Raw originals and independent audit are retained; the narrow guards now skip those jobs. See `docs/improvements/keel-wake-ci-preparation-results.md` and `docs/improvements.md`.

Hourly monitor remains paused by user instruction. Implementation author does not merge this PR.

title: Record future tournament games and align bot profile results
body:
Future tournament games now retain official replay recordings, and bot profiles show aligned Round/Opponent/Score/Points columns. This follows independently merged PR #116 and preserves its history.

The recorder adds the official observer recorder to the existing battle adapter without changing frozen battle settings or completion barriers. Each `.battle.gz` retains a local SHA256/size record and gzip check. Recorder paths and frames are not passed to bots. Public result exports contain official scores only; raw recordings, models and private logs stay local. Round 4 is the first recorded cohort; earlier games were not rerun.

The completed Swiss evidence covers 70 validated games / 1,400 competitive rounds, plus 20 excluded solo startup rounds. All 14 Round 4 recordings passed game-boundary and 20-round coverage checks. Final standings and top-eight qualification are included. No playoff game has started, and playoff automation is outside this PR.

The user-approved public Site offers a replay selector and **Play all Round 4 games**, with live energy, cumulative official scores and round jumps for each game. Fourteen rendered H.264 movies cover all 280 Round 4 battle rounds. Playback defaults to 0.25× (15 simulation turns/sec), with 0.125× available for slower viewing. The chosen speed carries between games. Movies load individually into browser Blobs for seeking on the current host; blocked automatic playback exposes a tap-to-play fallback. Guest styling and public noindex/nofollow directives remain.

Validation: 12 tournament tests pass; the recording adapter compiles against pinned runner 1.4.0 and received independent review. Each video is checked against its source recording hash and official final scores, 20 chapters, H.264/yuv420p metadata, frame count and duration. JavaScript syntax and nonbrowser playlist/speed/round-jump/cleanup/autoplay-fallback checks pass. Browser playback/layout QA is unavailable under current Work settings. No gameplay edits, extra battles or Actions dispatched by this task; commits use `[skip ci]`.

This PR includes renderer source, running documentation, the clean website template and 70 official score arrays. Rendered media are hosted on the Site, not committed here. Full raw game artifacts remain retained locally on minimind.

body:

Against Diamond, candidate share was25.505051% (1/5 wins) versus v3 control12.397820% (0/5), but it missed the required>35% and took128.732704 uncapped damage/100 enemy shots versus control98.924016. body:

title: Fix Meridian v3 gun-alignment starvation
body:
Meridian v3 can keep reversing its aim while the gun slews, leaving a cold, affordable gun unable to align. This change holds the selected signed aim offset and power until firing or invalidation, tracks live line of sight, and constructs learning context from the actual firing-turn state. Existing alignment, scan freshness, heat, energy/reserve checks and other gameplay remain unchanged.

Stacked on PR #81 (`codex/meridian-aim`, baseline `809b880cdcee98d7946d05e6bcd30f623f604348`). Prospective comparison: #90.

Validation:
- 24/24 candidate tests passed on actual Java 17 and were independently rerun; untouched v3 passed 10/10.
- Legal-input replay reproduces all 244 shots and the 2,894-turn no-fire stall. The committed-plan servo reaches the unchanged alignment guard in two steps within the predeclared bound. This establishes liveness only, not hits or wins.
- Baseline and production source/JAR parity passed; all 14 candidate classes match the direct Java 17 compile.
- Independent implementation review passed with no source correctness blocker.
- Five production floating-point golden failures reproduce identically on pristine v3 under the same Mac/Java 17 runtime. The full production suite remains non-green; no tolerance was changed.

Draft pending the authorized, separately registered 60-round comparison and Linux validation. No fresh games have run. The reviewed benchmark harness is prepared locally; its publication is pending authenticated Git access, and the [runtime-readiness clarification](https://github.com/stephanelee/robocode/issues/90#issuecomment-6621314260) is published, while authenticated Git/Actions access remains pending. `[skip ci]` prevents the repository's automatic PR battle workflows from consuming games outside the registered protocol. Required CI remains pending; do not merge on these offline results.
